messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty incident triggered for service=infra-inference-gateway-prod (priority: P1). Automatic page to #incidents and on-call. PD:INC1234567 link=https://pagerduty.example/INC1234567

incident-bot: symptom=upstream 5xx spike, metric=inference_gateway.5xx_rate, region=us-west2, threshold=5%

sarah-sre: acked in PD, i'm on it. grabbing logs + starting triage. anyone see related deploys? :coffee:

iris-oncall: seeing same. error rate jumped ~ 10m ago. quick check: top-5 downstream errors look like 502/504 from edge-proxy -> inference-gateway.

liam-eng: oncall noticed increased queue depth on gateway workers, also KV cache eviction spiked. i’m pulling pod logs and kvcache metrics now.

maria-support: heads-up — a handful of customers reported timeouts via support channel, severity medium for now. prepping a status note if impact grows.

sarah-sre: quick snapshot:```
5xx_rate: 12.4% (baseline ~0.3%)
5xx_count: 870/min
latency_p95: 1.1s -> 2.6s
regions: us-west2 primarily
errors: 502, 504, 503
```

sarah-sre: immediate mitigation plan: 1) scale up inference-gateway pool in us-west2 2) enable fallback-routing to dedicated-capacity pool 3) warm KV cache entries.

liam-eng: scaling now: `kubectl -n prod scale deployment inference-gateway --replicas=20` — bumping from 8 -> 20 to absorb burst. watching pods come up.

deploy-bot: deployment/inference-gateway scaled to 20 replicas

iris-oncall: routing fallback: creating route override to send 20% traffic to dedicated nodes (policy: degrade_to_dedicated). applying canary split.

liam-eng: applied route override:```
PATCH /routing/policy
{ "from": "inference-gateway:us-west2", "to": "dedicated-usw2", "weight": "20%" }
```

maria-support: posting interim status to customers who reported via support: "We're investigating increased errors in us-west2 and have applied mitigations; we'll update in 15 minutes."

sarah-sre: kvcache warmup in progress. running a hot-prefix replay for common prefixes to repopulate caches: `./tools/warm_prefixes --top=1000 --region=us-west2`

liam-eng: seeing partial recovery — 5xx rate down to ~4.8% and latency falling. heatmap shows error sources concentrated on instances with older CUDA driver (driver mismatch). rolling those nodes via cluster autoscaler to replace with correct image.

iris-oncall: PD notes: assigned to sarah-sre, escalation path intact, no paging to on-call rotation beyond this channel. marking as under active mitigation.

sarah-sre: action items: - confirm full rollback of route after recovery - run post-incident runbook to capture root cause (driver mismatch + cache stampede) - follow up with infra to enforce image pinning in us-west2 node pool

liam-eng: opened github issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/issues/956 - includes logs and kube events.

maria-support: will send a targeted customer update once we confirm stable for 30 mins. current impact: intermittent 502/504 for ~7% of requests during peak, limited to us-west2.

sarah-sre: last check: 5xx_rate=0.9%, latency_p95=1.0s. leaving scaled replicas for 20m then scale down. marking PD incident as "monitoring" but not closed.

incident-bot: PD INC1234567 status changed: acknowledged -> monitoring. next update scheduled in 15m.

iris-oncall: thanks all. postmortem owner: liam-eng + sarah-sre. will run RCA and include mitigation improvements (image pin, early kvcache warming heuristic, better autopager filters). :thumbsup:

sarah-sre: closing thread for now — ping here if anything regresses.
